senses.gloss: (b. h.), Pi. שִׁסֵּף (cmp. preced.) to split, to hew in pieces.
units: <cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 3:22">Lam. R. to III, 64</cite> (ref. to <he>וישסף</he>, <cite ref="I Samuel 15:33">I Sam. XV, 33</cite>) <he>שחתכו וכ׳</he> he cut him in four pieces. Sifra Thazriʿa Par. 5, ch. XVI <he>יְשַׁסְּפֶנּוּ</he> Rabad, v. <cite ref="U01819"><he>שָׁצַף</he></cite>.
